notlar.en: Works with the game in all 15 languages; shows the game language, your avatar, power and window size; can close game popups.
notlar.tr: Oyunun 15 dilinin hepsinde çalışır; oyun dilini, avatarınızı, gücünüzü ve pencere boyutunu gösterir; oyunun açılır pencerelerini kapatabilir.

yeni: Works with the game in all 15 of its languages: Headquarters/World detection no longer depends on the Turkish button text
Shows the game language, your avatar, current power (CP) and the game window size
Optional: closes game popups that block the screen while you are away (Settings)
gelistirme: Better detection at different window sizes (templates now scale with the window height)

yeni: Microsoft Store support: the Store version is updated by the Store and uses the Windows startup settings
gelistirme: Privacy policy page on the website
Alliance help is now also given while the chat is open (the help button shows up on the right side of the chat)
duzeltme: The help button next to the chat messages was detected but not pressed

yeni: Update check: the app looks for a new version once a day on startup and on demand from About
New-version notification that opens the download page with one click
English is now the default language (Turkish is still available)
gelistirme: Groundwork for first-aid automation: the hospital panel, help request and healed-soldier icons are recognised (not enabled yet)
Code-signing support in the build pipeline (executable, libraries, installer and uninstaller)
Version and publisher information embedded in the executable
Website, version information and downloads moved to GitHub

yeni: System tray icon with Show, Start/Stop and Exit menu
Option to minimize to the system tray
Multiple languages (English, Turkish); language changes apply instantly
First-run setup: choose language and preferences
About window and website link in the status bar
gelistirme: Installer asks for its language and passes it to the app

yeni: Automatic alliance help while the game is on the Headquarters or World screen
Game status light (Survival.exe running or not) and current screen display
Start/Stop button and global shortcut (Ctrl+Alt+H by default)
Help counter for the current session (only confirmed helps are counted)
Warning notification above the taskbar when help cannot be given for too long
gelistirme: Real-mouse clicks that return the cursor and focus instantly and wait for you to be idle
